initial_reference: medoid of the last 9 consecutive valid frames strictly before the fixed V1 start frame; never use manual times
initial_reference_caveat: V1 start is delayed; its preceding frames are an operational reference, not verified neutral head pose
center: SO3 geodesic medoid minimizing sum of pairwise distances among block matrices; earliest frame breaks exact ties
confirmation_center: first-block medoid frozen; second-block support measured against this same center
initial_separation: both block medoids must be strictly farther than 2*radius from initial reference medoid; disjoint equal-radius regions around centers
scan: every possible first-block start from each fixed V1 base start through clip end; do not truncate using V1 end; preserve overlapping accepted and rejected windows
candidate_interval: first block start through first block end; not an exact physical endpoint
confirmation_time: last sample of the subsequent non-overlapping 9-frame block; decision needs future samples relative to the reported candidate interval
family_summary: contiguous accepted window-start indices only; not distinct events or a globally fixed region
invalid_policy: no imputation or bridging; missing reference/data and incomplete blocks are explicit unconfirmed/rejected records
